about_short_description.short_description: Hapax Labs is a HOA manager that specializes in combining technology and operations, offering real-time information.

product.name: HOA Management Service
product.description: A service providing comprehensive management of homeowners associations, including financial transparency, contract negotiation, and community communication.

product.name: Community Financial Transparency and Accounting
product.description: A system that provides real-time access to community financial data, including invoices, expenses, and budget tracking for homeowners associations.

product.name: Digital Meeting and Voting Platform
product.description: A platform enabling online, hybrid, and asynchronous meetings and voting for homeowners associations.

identifier.value: Contract Renegotiation and Cost Reduction Service

product.name: Contract Renegotiation and Cost Reduction Service
product.description: A service focused on renegotiating supply and maintenance contracts to reduce community expenses for homeowners associations.

product.name: Free Community Savings Study
product.description: A complimentary analysis service that evaluates community expenses to identify potential monthly savings for homeowners associations.
